spans.s: डींन् fem. affix ई added to words in the class headed by शार्ङ्गरव: cf.
. Words ending with this affix ङीन् have their first vowel accented acute.
डिनि (l) tad. affix applied to अवान्तर- दीक्षा, तिलव्रत etc. in the sense of चरति (observing); e.g. तिलव्रती, cf.
Vart 3; (2) applied in the sense of 'having as measurement'applied to numeral words ending in शत् or शिन् and the word विंशति; e.g. त्रिंशिनो मासाः, विंशिनोङ्गिरसः; cf. M. Bh. on
